Ikeja Depot Shop, Dairy Chiller audit (confidence 0.77, compliance 67%).

Two planogram SKUs are showing zero facings but stock IS in the back room — no purchase order needed, just a shelf refill:

1. Peak Evaporated Milk 160g — 0 facings, expected 3. On hand: 13 units (reorder point 6). Fill to 9 units / 3 facings.
2. Hollandia Yoghurt 1L — 0 facings, expected 4. On hand: 10 units (reorder point 6). Fill the full 4 facings; 10 units is slightly under the 12-unit target, so put the whole lot out.

The other four SKUs (Peak Powdered 400g, Three Crowns Evap 160g, Cowbell Sachet 12g, Dano Cool Cow 400g) are at expected facings — no action.

No reorder raised: both SKUs sit above their reorder points. Heads-up that Hollandia Yoghurt 1L will drop to roughly the reorder point once the shelf is filled, so expect it on the next order cycle. No fridge telemetry was available for this chiller — if the yoghurt and evaporated milk are emptying faster than usual, please confirm the chiller is holding temperature.
